name: Ariana
source:
Mira's older sister

Although she mainly hunts using magic,  she is good at supportive magic such as recovery.

The only offensive magic she can use is fire magic. She is more worried about Mira than ever before because Ariana is engaged to the son of the village chief and will soon be married.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
